Hi @samdoran  When I added the OS flavours for the testcases, your build is failing with "value_specified_in_no_log_parameter" for the updated values for minimum and maximum days. The actual values are not being updated, but inplace of the value you can see "value_specified_in_no_log_parameter". You tried by running the testcase as root but still it didn't work.

The way `no_log` works is by replacing _all_ occurrences of the value with "value_specified_in_no_log_parameter". I understand why these values should be hidden, but very short and non-unique strings specified as `no_log` values will have unintended consequences and should be avoided.

- Feature Idea

user_module - https://docs.ansible.com/ansible/latest/modules/user_module.html
